answer: In an agent economy coordinating freight through an umber canyon, the kernel of sybil resistance is a mandatory bond: each identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days before bidding on jobs. Creating 1,000 eligible identities therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for a month, imposing financing costs even if none wins work. Splitting one wallet into many addresses cannot multiply influence for free, because each address needs its own funded bond.
